freight.title: Estimate freight
freight.pinHelp: Uses the PIN from Deliver to. You can change it here.
freight.qtyInvalid: Enter a whole quantity of 1 or more.
freight.disclaimer: This is an estimate only. The final freight is quoted by the seller.
freight.a_weight_default: The seller has not listed a packed weight, so we assumed a default weight per unit.
freight.a_dims_missing: The seller has not listed pack dimensions, so only actual weight was used.
freight.a_origin_unknown: The seller's location is not known, so a long-distance lane was assumed.
freight.a_destination_unknown: We could not place that PIN code, so a long-distance lane was assumed.
freight.a_volumetric_applied: Pack volume is larger than weight, so volumetric weight was charged.
freight.a_multi_vehicle: The load needs more than one truck.
freight.a_provider_fallback: Live carrier rates were unavailable, so our standard rate card was used.
freight.a_excludes_pickup_delivery_extras: Loading, unloading, and local surcharges are not included.
freight.landedNote: Product GST is not included because it depends on the product's tax rate.
freight.err_invalid_quantity: Enter a whole quantity of 1 or more.
freight.err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.
freight.err_unavailable: Freight estimates are unavailable right now. Please try again later.
freight.err_not_found: This product is not available for estimates.
freight.cmpQuoted: Includes the seller's stated delivery charge.
freight.cmpEstimated: Includes estimated freight of {low} to {high}, because the seller has not stated a charge.
freight.cmpNone: Freight not stated, so not included.
freight.cmpGstAssumed: Includes GST on goods at an assumed 18%, because the seller says GST is extra.
freight.cmpGstUnknown: GST not stated by the seller, so not added.
freight.cmpNote: Landed cost is goods plus GST plus freight. Freight is the seller's charge where stated, otherwise our estimate. The final freight is quoted by the seller.
